title: Los Angeles Equestrian Center

services.name: Horse Shows
services.desc: Host Your Next Horse Show at the Los Angeles Equestrian Center. Situated in the picturesque Griffith Park and spread across 75 acres, LAEC combines historic charm with unparalleled accessibility. Just minutes from Los Angeles’ premier hotels, restaurants, and attractions and conveniently close to two major freeways, LAEC is the perfect choice for horse show promoters seeking an exceptional venue. From its deluxe 3,500 fixed-seat arena to its beautifully appointed pavilion complex and the outdoor splendor of its exhibition fields, the Los Angeles Equestrian Center is a multi-use masterpiece. The result of an unprecedented commitment to quality and service, years of planning and construction,
